entry.name: mc.click~
entry.description: Use the click~ to create and output an impulse which can be used as an impulse-trigger.

arguments.name: wavetable-values
arguments.description: A list of floating-point values in the range 0.0-1.0, can be used to specify an impulse (i.e., a small wavetable) whose length is determined by the number of list elements. The maximum size for the list is 256 items.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends an impulse out theobject's outlet. The default impulse consists of a single value (1.0), followed by zero values.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Sends an impulse scaled by the value of the number. The default impulse consists of a the value of the input number followed by zero values. If an impulse wavetable has been defined with themessage, the values in the table will be scaled by the input.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Sends an impulse scaled by the value of the number.

messages.name: set
messages.description: The word, followed by a list of floating-point values in the range 0.0-1.0, specifies a impulse (i.e., a small wavetable) whose length is determined by the number of list elements. The maximum size for the list is 256 items.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: A signal will trigger clicks on zero to non-zero transitions.
